scope: Captured from an isolated owned C-Gate daemon and disposable fake PCI. No house, Docker service, telephone equipment, or live C-Bus network was used. Payloads exclude the optional PCI checksum and confirmation character.

application.registry_evidence: The retained application.spe maps telephony to E0/E0/E0 and CBusTelephonyApplication.

help: 101-Help:  TELEPHONY CLEAR_DIVERSION - Command the telephony device to clear any diversion
101-Help:  TELEPHONY DIVERT - Set a diversion for the telephony device
101-Help:  TELEPHONY ISOLATE_SECONDARY_OUTLET - Set the isolation mode for the telephony device
101-Help:  TELEPHONY RECALL_LAST_NUMBER_REQUEST - Request a last number recall from the telephony device
101 Help:  TELEPHONY REJECT_INCOMING_CALL - Command the telephony device to reject the incoming call

commands.note: Native defect: Java counts one UTF-16 character but converts the two signed UTF-8 bytes through an FF fallback, producing one undeclared trailing byte.

validated_boundaries.application: Telephony application 224 (0xE0); decimal, $E0, selected-project and full-project paths
validated_boundaries.divert_number: exactly one whitespace-delimited token; Java UTF-16 length 1..16; quotes and backslash escape spelling are literal, not shell-style decoded
validated_boundaries.single_byte_number_event: retained decoder inserts a separator only when a line-off-hook or last-number value is longer than one byte; a one-byte value is concatenated (for example out data1 or in1)
validated_boundaries.wire_length: short SAL prefixes use their low three length bits; extended 0x80-prefixed forms use the low five bits

negative_examples.response: 401 Bad object or device ID: 253/224 (Network not found)
400 Syntax Error: String parameter is too long : <number>

inbound_events.note: Native inserts a separator only when the decoded number is longer than one byte.
The qualifier byte after opcode 05 is ignored in native event text.
Native inserts a separator only when the decoded number is longer than one byte.

authorization: All five native command classes declare Program access. cmqttd's optional LOGIN gate is deliberately operation-based rather than access.txt parity: diversion, isolation, rejection and clear operations are gated; the last-number request remains available as a read/request command.
acceptance_boundary: A cmqttd 200 response establishes active-generation PCI-confirmed broadcast delivery only. Telephone-unit acceptance, call state, durable diversion and real telephone hardware were not tested. Bridged-network routing remains unsupported. Telephony traffic is fanned to C-Gate EVENT subscribers and intentionally creates no MQTT entity or state schema.
